official.deadline_note: Merit scholarships: applications from 1 October 2026 to 31 October 2026. Study grants: from 1 September 2026 to 20 September 2026 and a second phase from 2 October 2026 to 22 October 2026.
official.status_note: Applications for merit scholarships are open from 1 to 31 October 2026; study grants have application phases in September and October 2026.
benefits: Merit scholarships of EUR 750 to 1,500 paid out in a single lump sum upon award
Study grants of EUR 750 to 3,600 for unfinished academic and scientific work (Diploma, Master's theses, doctoral dissertations)
Borealis-MORE-Scholarship for refugee students in a regular study programme, sponsored by Borealis AG
IRIS FISCHLMAYR scholarships and awards for outstanding scientific work with a diversity reference, including a dissertation grant for junior female academics in engineering and natural sciences
Study Abroad Scholarship for a study-relevant stay abroad
eligibility: Merit scholarship: degree programme completed within the allotted time with an average GPA of no less than 2.0, or a deserving Diploma/Master's thesis or doctoral dissertation
Study grants: unfinished academic and scientific work whose groundwork costs are not covered by the supervising institute's budget or other sources
MORE scholarships: refugee students enrolled in the university preparation programme (MOREclassic) or a regular study programme
IRIS FISCHLMAYR: junior female academics and scientists in engineering and natural sciences
requirements: Merit scholarship: online application with the calculation sheet uploaded as a PDF
Study grants: application with cost calculation and budget
selection_criteria: Fundability of the work and costs not covered by other sources (study grants)
coverage: Merit scholarship: single lump sum of EUR 750 to 1,500 paid upon award
Study grants: EUR 750 to 3,600 supplementing groundwork costs for unfinished academic work
application_method: Apply via the online form at zulassung.jku.at, available only in German
Application documents (call, calculation sheet, cost calculation and budget) are published per scheme
official.application_route: Online application via zulassung.jku.at during the published window; outcomes are notified by email
official.international_eligibility: The published pages state no nationality restriction for merit scholarships and study grants; the online application form is only available in German
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: IRIS FISCHLMAYR: engineering and natural sciences, with work including a reference to diversity
official.research_requirement: Study grants require an unfinished thesis or dissertation with a cost calculation and financing plan
official.description: JKU Linz awards merit scholarships of EUR 750 to 1,500 as a single lump sum for outstanding achievement and study grants of EUR 750 to 3,600 for unfinished theses, alongside the Borealis-MORE scholarship for refugee students and the IRIS FISCHLMAYR awards, with applications submitted through the university's online portal.
official.program_type: University scholarship hub: merit scholarships, study grants, refugee and diversity awards

not_confirmed: citizenship_residency rules for the merit and study grant schemes
verification.notes: Amounts confirmed verbatim from the official pages: merit scholarships 'range from EUR 750 to 1,500' paid 'in a single lump sum upon award', and study grants 'may not be less than EUR 750 but cannot exceed EUR 3,600'. The single funding_amount field carries the published lower bound of the merit scholarship, with the full ranges recorded in benefits and coverage. Windows confirmed: merit 1-31 October 2026; study grants 1-20 September 2026 and 2-22 October 2026.

applicant_utility.summary: JKU pays merit scholarships of EUR 750-1,500 as a single lump sum for completing your degree on time with a GPA of at least 2.0, and study grants of EUR 750-3,600 for unfinished theses, both through the university's online form (German only). The 2026 windows are 1-31 October for merit awards and September/October phases for study grants; refugee students can look at the Borealis-MORE scholarship.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Students who finish on time with strong grades, thesis writers with documented research costs, and refugee students in a regular degree programme.
application_readiness_checklist: Merit scholarship: apply 1-31 October 2026 via zulassung.jku.at with the calculation sheet uploaded as PDF
Study grants: use the 1-20 September or 2-22 October 2026 window with cost calculation and budget
Check the GPA of at least 2.0 and on-time completion criteria for the merit route
Refugee students: check the Borealis-MORE scholarship sponsored by Borealis AG
common_rejection_risks: Missing the narrow October window for merit awards
Submitting without the calculation sheet, which the office asks to be uploaded as PDF
Assuming the study grant is a living stipend - it covers thesis groundwork costs not funded elsewhere
Applying for a study grant for costs already covered by the supervising institute's budget
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: General living costs; both schemes are one-off payments, and study grants exclude costs covered by other sources.
document_audit: The online form is only available in German - arrange translation help early if needed
Study grants need a cost calculation and budget; merit awards need the official calculation sheet
alerts: Applications are only accepted via the online form during the published windows
Decisions are notified by email after the window closes
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Pick the scheme -> complete the online form at zulassung.jku.at in the window -> upload calculation sheet or budget -> outcome by email.
